_description: Manual ground truth for CGRR. Each cluster lists relation_type strings (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, as the extractor emits) that denote the same predicate and should all normalise to the same canonical relation_type. The 'canonical' field is the relation_type CGRR's normalize_map should resolve every alias to. Relation types that appear only once with no synonymous alternative should NOT be listed here.
